title: Module 9 - Portfolio Management, Asset Allocation, and Performance

assets.alt_text: Governed portfolio lifecycle from the investment policy statement and risk budget through expectations, allocation, construction, implementation, performance, monitoring, and policy review, with an efficient-frontier inset.
production_notes: Keep labels short: IPS, risk budget, expectations, allocation, construction, implementation, performance, monitoring, exceptions, review.
Do not use fake tickers or fake numerical coordinates.
Use the efficient frontier only as a small inset; the executed notebooks already provide the full analytical chart.
Generate from code so the governance loop and process order remain exact.
assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Academic governed portfolio lifecycle for Module 9. Show the ordered process IPS -> objectives and risk budget -> capital market expectations -> allocation and construction -> implementation and rebalancing -> performance and attribution -> monitoring and exceptions -> IPS review. Add a small schematic efficient-frontier inset inside the allocation step, not as the dominant chart. Use off-white background, navy linework, teal allocation and performance accents, amber governance highlights, and coral exception markers. Keep a 7% safe margin. No fake tickers, coordinates, recommendations, logos, or dense formulas.
